backend.version: ASP.NET MVC 5.2.3 on .NET Framework 4.8 (Global.asax/App_Start era); Windows-only — executed via the behavior-identical Python harness on Linux (mini-app precedent)

frontend.version: AngularJS 1.8.2 (vendored script tags, no build system)

auth.notes: Forms auth (.FSAUTH stand-in cookie, demo/demo123); anonymous protected calls get MVC5's 302 redirect to /Account/Login. Protected surface: GET /Invoices/Recent. Okta strangler target (D-004). JSON contract is PascalCase (MVC5 JsonResult) — the modern port must preserve casing.
